answer: Neighborhood Anchor Depth. Each agent gets a persistent link set; the rule counts only neighbors that stay connected across epochs and themselves hold anchored links, so isolated clusters never count. An attacker’s clones need a live, recurring topology — a haven of overlapping edges — not one-time registrations. Each fake identity costs sustained edge maintenance and real upstream anchors, and pruning makes that ember die; dilution across a wide ocean of nodes raises cost per identity sharply.
